item.text: The refactor exposed a packaging mistake in `GraphBuilder.java`: its `package graph;` declaration was dropped. I’m fixing that now and recompiling.

I refactored adjacency-list storage into a dedicated helper, [graph/AdjacencyLists.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/graph/AdjacencyLists.java:7). That moves the mutable-neighbor lists, stable read-only views, and immutable snapshot creation into one place, instead of having `GraphBuilder` manage those details itself.

With that in place, [graph/GraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/graph/GraphBuilder.java:3) is smaller and only coordinates graph construction, while [graph/AbstractAdjacencyGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/004_breadth_first_search/graph/AbstractAdjacencyGraph.java:5) still owns the shared `Graph` view behavior. Verification passed with `javac BreadthFirstSearch.java graph/*.java graph/traversal/*.java graph/samples/*.java` and `java BreadthFirstSearch`; output remains `0 2 3 1 4 5`.
